method: Reopened all 35 exact selected questions with options and solutions. Manually rederived each key, inspected distractors, repaired four stems and one distractor, checked amended answers and revised alternatives. Structural verification across 35. This is a second AI pass, not external examiner approval. Grade-demand classification remains qualitative, not a fresh released-paper calibration. Other 81 retain existing scope dispositions; only triaged, not newly solved or re-reviewed.
limits: Do not release any selected question on this register alone. The 39 remaining later/extension rows require school evidence or redesign; 29 additional prerequisites require confirmation. Thirteen rewritten items retain a difficulty hold; no final approval. Vercel skipped.
